title: RSA-PSS tests only cover sLen=0; no explicit sLen test
description: test_soft_rsa_pss sets pss_params.sLen=0 (hash-length salt via RSA_PSS_SALT_LEN_DEFAULT mapping) but never tests explicit non-zero sLen (e.g. sLen=32 for SHA-256). If the sLen->salt_len mapping regresses for non-zero values, no test catches it. Also missing: a round-trip C_Sign -> C_Verify on the same key+session to confirm sign and verify compose correctly (current test only does Part A: wp11-sign vs oracle-verify, and Part B: oracle-sign vs wp11-verify).
